summary: Plano has an official city-maintained polygon Owner Parcels service with documented native PARCEL_ID and WKID 102738, but bounded anonymous feature requests timed out. The packet is complete as research evidence, with no retained GeoJSON sample and no source admission.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: See city-6650-plano.json requestsAndEndpointChecks. English and English-local discovery queries were executed and their actual URLs recorded. Metadata discovery succeeded through indexed official REST pages; direct service-directory and bounded query requests timed out.
scopeLimits: The Owner Parcels description claims parcels in Collin and Denton counties within Plano city limits; this scope was not independently verified by returned features.
The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted. Exact-point timeout and absent geometry are not citywide absence evidence.
No polygon was retained because no unchanged native geometry response was received.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.

nativeIdentityReview.fallback: OBJECTID only as an Esri source identifier if PARCEL_ID is unavailable

uncertainty: Service availability and response behavior may be transient.
The official layer metadata establishes a relevant city custodian and a plausible parcel source, not a verified usable response or citywide coverage.
A separate Active Parcels with Appraisal Information layer was discovered but not queried for records.
